{{Top|leg}}
An '''assault laser cannon''' was an extremely powerful, yet short-ranged, type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] sometimes installed on [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="SotG" />

==Characteristics==
Assault laser cannons had extremely high damage output, rivaling that of a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]], but were hampered by a severe lack of range.<ref name="SotG">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]'' Based on a damage output of 9d10x2 which puts its damage output on par with double turbolasers in the same source, such as with the 'Dead Reckoning'.</ref> Because of this, assault laser cannons were only useful at short to moderate distances, and had no long range ability as they became progressively inaccurate past short-range.<ref name="SotG" /> Due to their power, they were sometimes installed on assault ships and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] craft.<ref name="SotG" />

==History==
The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Granakk]]'s [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], [[Reckoning (YT-1300 light freighter)|''Reckoning'']], had a single assault laser cannon installed on it.<ref name="ADV">''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]''</ref> During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Erron Kell]]'s ''[[Deathraven]]'' was equipped with four assault laser cannons.<ref name="SotG" /> The ''[[Krakana's Claw]]'' was equipped with twin fire-linked assault laser cannons.<ref name="SotG" /> Additionally, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] ship [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']] was equipped with two assault laser cannons.<ref name="Collection8">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 8|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 8]]</ref>
